answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the ledge bond on all of them and exposing each to the ember slash. Because the dawn audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 14 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Each impostor pays 4 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
